name: claude-fleet
description: A status-bar button that opens the live background-Claude sessions as writable panes in the terminal panel you are already looking at, in groups of three.

commands.title: Claude Fleet: Open live sessions in this panel (groups of 3)
Claude Fleet: Open just the freshest group
Claude Fleet: Watch live sessions (read-only tails)
Claude Fleet: Pick which sessions to open
Claude Fleet: All sessions in ONE terminal
Claude Fleet: Reply to a session (claude agents)
Claude Fleet: Close the fleet terminals

claudeFleet.panes.markdownDescription: How many sessions go side by side in ONE terminal tab. Anything beyond this opens as further tabs in the list down the right of the panel — 8 live sessions at 3 give you three tabs of 3, 3 and 2. Past about 4 the panes get too narrow to read.

claudeFleet.confirmAbove.markdownDescription: Ask first when opening more than this many WRITABLE panes at once. Each one runs its own `claude` process, and this machine has lost VS Code to memory pressure before. Set to `0` to never ask.

claudeFleet.maxAgeMinutes.description: Ignore sessions whose state file has not been touched in this many minutes (a whole number). A pane passes this same cutoff to `fleet open`, so any value here can be opened.

claudeFleet.reachableOnly.description: Skip sessions that are listed as live but whose daemon socket is gone — a pane on one of those shows a frozen transcript.

claudeFleet.fleetPath.description: Absolute path to the 'fleet' script. Leave empty to auto-detect.
